answer.rationale: Negotiating terms at renewal directly targets the 18% cost mandate. Memory_c4 confirms prior success in recovering margin via benchmarking against market rates. The incumbent relationship provides proven stability (memory_c1) and volume pricing leverage (memory_c6), both critical given the 94% capacity utilization with no buffer. Switching vendors (memory_c2) or adding a second source (memory_c3) would risk supply disruption within the 14-day window, while deferring (memory_c5) is impossible due to contract expiration. Negotiation is the only viable path to achieve the cost reduction without increasing delivery risk.
